createWcMandate.title: Create a job mandate under one of your workflows
createWcMandate.description: A job mandate is one role: its details and the assessment candidates sit (difficulty, which question types, how many, marks, pass mark, duration). It starts with no questions: write them with `POST /mandates/{mandate_id}/questions/generate` (Record's AI writes them from the job) or supply your own with `PUT /mandates/{mandate_id}/questions`. A campaign can be created once the questions are `ready`. The workflow must be a white-collar, recruiter-led one of your organisation.

createWcCampaign.title: Create a campaign for one of your job mandates, and start it
createWcCampaign.description: Invites candidates to the job's assessment by email: each gets a link to take it. The job's questions must be `ready` and the job open. `start: now` sends the invitations at once, in the background (the campaign reads `sending` until everyone has been reached); `start: manual` only creates it, start it later with `POST /campaigns/{id}/start`. This emails real people and spends credits, so it needs the `wc_campaigns:write` scope, an `Idempotency-Key`, and is capped per day. An organisation that cannot pay answers 402 before anything is created. An address that is invalid or repeated is returned in `rejected` with the reason; the rest go ahead.

pullWcEvents.title: Pull your result events and confirm the last ones
pullWcEvents.description: The same `assessment.result` events the webhook sends, for pulling, in one call: send the `ack` ids of the events you processed from the previous call, and get the next page back. With the default `status=unacked` you get every event you have not acknowledged, oldest first, so one you missed or failed to process comes again. Loop: process the page, pass its ids as `ack` of the next call, repeat. A call whose response is lost loses nothing: its events were not acknowledged yet and come again. Acknowledging is safe to repeat (ids already acknowledged, or unknown, are accepted) and also closes a webhook delivery still waiting for them. `status=all` (with `from`) replays history; events are kept 30 days. `after` is only a paging shortcut: rely on `unacked`. An event is written once a candidate's attempt has ended (completed, timed out, disqualified, or the invitation failed) and its result has stayed the same for a short while.

createWcWebhookEndpoint.title: Add a webhook endpoint
createWcWebhookEndpoint.description: Record sends every white-collar result event (`assessment.result`) to this URL and retries until you answer 2xx (about 52 hours, then the delivery is kept as dead and can be replayed). Each request is signed with your API secret key (VFN_SK_...), so there is no extra secret to keep. Registering a URL you already have returns that endpoint (`existing: true`), never a second one. At most 5 endpoints. `backfill_from` also sends results from the past 30 days; leave it out to receive only new ones.
